name: GitHub Copilot
verdict_reason: Tabby self-hosts code completion competently — on a GPU you have to rent or own. $10/mo buys frontier-model completions; a capable inference GPU runs multiples of that in electricity alone. The math inverts only if idle GPU hardware already exists in your house.
what_you_lose: Frontier model quality at a subsidized price — Copilot is cheaper than the compute it uses
